evidence_scope: train/valid dev only; NO reserved (J03WQQ) or external (SoccerTrack) reads

model.class: AMRModelV5 (scripts/amr_model_v5.py): FULLY DECOUPLED dual towers, ZERO shared parameters
model.encoder_ctx: GraphEncoder serving context channel only (raw view, frozen context_loss)
model.encoder_mode: GraphEncoder serving intrinsic/routing pathway only (centered view)
model.gate: NONE in R1 (deliberate; frozen-eval interface requires train/eval isomorphism; learned sharing deferred to R3+ follow-up if R1 passes)
model.only_variable_vs_v4b: encoder shared -> split; schedule/weights/losses/sampling/eval ALL identical to v4b

routing_assignment.rule: all bands recoverable (normalized direction recovery); stop-grad asymmetry (perturbed predicts fixed clean target); restricted eqv heads 32->4 (predictor analog)
routing_assignment.sampling: Slepian vectors per (support S in same-team size 2..5, band b); mu reported per update; empty-band fallback resamples (documented)
routing_assignment.confinement: route + triplet + VICReg touch mode tower (+heads) ONLY; ctx tower sees context loss ONLY (unit-tested both directions)

losses.L_route: normalized direction recovery vs exact pooled band target
losses.L_vicvar: VICReg variance hinge on FINAL raw z_mode (bypasses intermediate-floor bypass)
losses.L_viccov: within-mode covariance decorrelation (cross-channel penalty dropped: says nothing about within-mode rank)

calibration.W_ROUTE_rationale: init grad-norm parity 0.4074/0.0340 = 11.98 -> 12.0 (documented starting point, not adaptive controller)
calibration.VIC_GAMMA_rationale: 0.02 sits below healthy alive-dim scale (~0.05), above collapse (0); active from init by design (breaks near-tie regime early); restoring gradient explodes as std->0 so small gamma still binds

training_protocol.optimizer: Adam lr=1e-3 wd=0 (joint; EM-alternation documented as deferred)
training_protocol.streams: context seed*100000, pair seed*200000, route seed*300000
training_protocol.data: IDSSE dev stand-in, train split only
training_protocol.early_stop: active-triplet fraction == 0.0 for 3 consecutive epochs -> COLLAPSED (pre-registered, saves compute)
training_protocol.schedule: v4b schedule verbatim: epochs 1-20 route-free warm-start, 21-40 linear ramp 0->2.0, full 2.0 after

evaluation_plan.frozen: valid context/intrinsic/translation metrics + t5r5_support_reallocation_v1 eps=0.25 intervention eval, verbatim code paths
evaluation_plan.added_diagnostics: valid z_mode singular top-10 (Jing), mu means per (band,support), active-triplet final, collapse flag
evaluation_plan.success_rule: H1/H2 descriptive; any systematic collapse -> v4 fails, M1存废 goes to user (no further autonomous redesign)
evaluation_plan.R1_decision: H1 pass -> AMR (branch-shaping) established, remaining rounds to N4; mode still collapses -> routing objective broken even protected -> R2 freeze-then-route; ctx anomaly (constructionally impossible) -> implementation bug, fix does not consume a round
